rooms.observation: Bed, pillow/headboard, wardrobe and bedside table establish a bedroom.
Sofa, rug, coffee table and television establish a living room.
Four desks with monitors and chairs plus filing cabinet establish an office.
Rows of student desks/chairs, teacher desk and wide board establish a classroom.
Three framed artworks, display plinths/sculptures and viewing bench establish a gallery.
Single compact bed, study desk and books on a shelf distinguish the small dorm from the larger bedroom.
Dense stacks of boxes constrain the accessible footprint and read as clutter.
Bare wall/floor shell without furniture reads as empty; the authored Desk Map remains.
Long narrow ground strip with repeated trees and rocks reads as a schematic outdoor trail.
Open paved square, central fountain, benches, lamps and planted corners read as a plaza.

composition.observation: Desktop default views now fit the full modeled room/floor with padding and preserve a separate Inspector. Landscape shows a sizable visible bedroom and complete surface controls after vertical page scrolling. Phone trail has a blank canvas in both themes, defeating room composition.

hierarchy.observation: Preview: room-name explicitly distinguishes the named synthetic environment from authored Desk Map. Environment selector, room label and Inspector provide clear context; desktop surface result captures close the picker so the aligned clue is visible.

typography.observation: Room names and desktop/phone shell labels remain readable. Small status text stays separated from geometry. In phone trail, clear labels cannot substitute for the missing represented environment.

spacing.observation: Desktop room padding now prevents clipped wall tops/floor corners. The portrait surface picker remains scrolled to lower rows and hides much of the room; it can be toggled, and result snapshots on desktop close it. Landscape preserves a substantial room area though the header is above the scroll position.

controls.observation: Desktop manual results visibly align on both walls, table and floor. Landscape now shows Move/Rotate/Scale/Snap/Surfaces and all eight surface choices. Blocked bed/wardrobe/chair remain disabled. A small part of Select is beneath the fixed shell at the captured scroll offset, without a demonstrated lost action.

contrast.observation: Light and dark shell controls remain readable. Desktop trail/plaza distant geometry fades noticeably. Phone classroom is severely washed out in light and nearly black in dark; phone trail has no visible room at all in either theme. This is a geometry visibility defect, beyond an optional color preference.

consistency.observation: All ten desktop environment identities and furnishing persist across appearances. Desktop light has Inspector closed while dark has it open, so apparent horizontal centering differs. Phone trail breaks consistency by losing all geometry in both themes despite matching labels.

states.observation: Inspected all 24 current room screenshots, six manual surface result/phone captures, and actual automatic wall-to-table recording frames. Room/manual/automatic browser run receipt has exitCode 0. Renderer-ready and overflow assertions do not establish visible geometry, as blank trail phone captures demonstrate.

responsive.observation: The prior 844x390 66 px canvas failure is repaired: screenshot shows the bedroom and complete surface list, with editing supported through vertical scrolling. Phone classroom is framed inside the canvas but heavily faded; phone trail is fully blank in both themes. Useful phone environment framing remains blocked.

keyboard.observation: Named controls, Undo/Redo and selected tool outlines remain visible; local surface test uses buttons and checks a rendered canvas height above 240 px in portrait/landscape. This review did not independently exercise exhaustive keyboard traversal or screen-reader output.

focus.observation: Select/Snap outlines and active Surfaces state remain apparent in captures. Focus restoration and complete tab traversal were not independently demonstrated. Blank phone environment is not corrected by visible focus/DOM assertions.

feedback.observation: Status confirms snapped and aligned to each chosen surface and that Undo is available. Automatic recording at 2 s shows Semantic surface WALL with a vertical clue; at 3 s it shows TABLE with a horizontal clue. Entire floor still emits internal floor furniture naming: optional wording polish.

motion.observation: Inspected actual room WebM frames at 10/20/21 s, showing distinct cluttered/empty room switches across appearances. Manual frames at 4/8 s show clear table result and viewport transition; automatic frames at 2/3 s show wall intent then table alignment. Sampling establishes meaningful outcomes, not sustained smoothness. Phone images remain primary evidence of blank trail.

continuity.observation: Desk Map remains across named room switches. Automatic saved-library entry selects Hidden Wall Message, preserves wall intent when automatic is enabled, then selects a table and exposes semantic TABLE. Source-bound tests cover unchanged scene on room switching, Undo/Redo and persisted restore; this review adds visible outcomes without claiming owner state or production data.

complexity.observation: Distinct furnishings make all ten desktop names understandable. Complete surfaces and explicit blocked support avoid a dense unexplained patch catalog. The picker overlays the room during selection; it is dismissed for clear desktop result review. Phone blank geometry adds an actual failure, not just UI density.

role-outcomes.observation: Creator can recognize all ten desktop environments and visibly inspect manual placement on full floor, two walls and clear table space. Actual automatic wall-to-table video confirms those bounded outcomes. Landscape editing is now usable; phone trail environment inspection/editing is blocked by missing visible geometry.

fallbacks.observation: Blocked support is disabled, placement status names Undo and the shell marks synthetic geometry/physical qualification pending. Provider/device fallback, physical sensing and production recovery are outside this focused review. Phone trail has no visible explanatory fallback for its blank room.

findings.observation: At 390x844 the Outdoor trail canvas has no visible trees, ground/path or selected object in either theme. Classroom is severely faded in both appearances. The labels/renderer readiness remain, but the Creator cannot recognize or inspect the trail geometry.
findings.sourceObservation: Fixed fog near 12/far 35 remains while camera distance scales by environment span ×1.3×inverse portrait aspect; this is consistent with the visible phone geometry disappearing beyond fog range.
findings.requiredOutcome: Recapture exact-source phone trail/classroom in both themes with recognizably visible geometry, while retaining full-room framing.

findings.observation: Portrait picker is scrolled to lower rows and covers much of the room. No permanently lost control is demonstrated; dismissing it gives a result inspection route. Optional presentation polish remains.
The button is Entire floor whereas confirmation says floor furniture; the rendered floor placement is clear, so this is a naming polish issue.

limitations: Local exact-source focused review only; protected integration, physical sensing/AR, production performance and owner acceptance are separate.
Only classroom/trail have named-room phone captures; no universal all-ten-mobile acceptance is claimed.
Surface result captures are dark; room identities are covered in both themes, but a complete placement/theme/device cross-product is not claimed.
Frame sampling does not establish sustained frame rate, exhaustive keyboard/screen-reader behavior or physical touch ergonomics.
No shared private preview, user content, paid inference or builder rationale inspected.

priorFindingDispositions.observation: Sizable visible bedroom, tool rail and complete surface controls replace the collapsed strip.
Picker is closed; the vertical map is visible below the window.
Map lies horizontally in clear table space in front of the lamp base.
Current default views show all modeled floor corners/wall tops inside the canvas chrome.

recordingInspectionMethod: Local Playwright ffmpeg extraction of specific actual WebM moments, followed by direct view_image inspection; no generated or reconstructed UI.
